# Mercer Press

## Inking

The Mercer press is inked each morning with 45 grams of black ink, worked for three minutes on the stone with a palette knife.

## Pressure

Damp paper at Mercer goes through at a pressure of 9 on the impression dial. The dial is set by the head printer at the start of the shift. Paper is damped at the trough and left under a board for two hours.

## Cleaning

The Mercer platen is cleaned every Thursday at 4 o'clock with spirit and a lint-free cloth.
